g.text: EPM1 — one versioned trie snapshot, embedded verbatim on both lanes
set mode has NO value table; map values are enumerated in the arena's value order
— one contiguous byte string, memoized `OnceLock<Vec<u8>>`, shared by the clone family
copies the SAME snapshot byte string
Lane B — bincode, cold store / LMDB
copies the SAME snapshot byte string
decode PDA reads the snapshot without a recursion ceiling —
depth 4,096 round-trips on a 256 KiB test stack.
Set mode ends at the arena
— there is no value table to
parse, and value-free terminating topology is representable
(something a `ps: Vec<Par>` projection structurally cannot say).
★ The cold snapshot cost is linear in trie nodes plus encoded
values. A cached `EpmLayout` retains only the topology prefix,
nested map-value chains. Warm access is
map-value table (map mode only; generated-PDA encoded)
Lane B carrier — bincode first field
